name: Playwright MCP
summary: MCP server that lets LLM agents drive a real browser through Playwright accessibility snapshots instead of screenshots.
description: A Model Context Protocol server for browser automation with Playwright. Agents interact with pages through structured accessibility snapshots rather than screenshots, so no vision model is needed. 45+ configuration flags cover browser choice, device emulation, profiles, proxies, permissions, timeouts and snapshot detail, and it installs into VS Code, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and other MCP clients.
contains: MCP server exposing Playwright browser automation tools
structured accessibility snapshots instead of screenshots
45+ CLI flags for browser, device, proxy, profile, permission and timeout settings
works with VS Code, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and more
